facts.fact: The annex to the Interior Ministry's circular no. 32 states that the integrated revenue system GIR-CT was deployed in 969 of 1,590 local authorities (collectivités territoriales, all tiers) as of 19 May 2020; it states a deployment, not that the offices are connected.

The annex to circular no. 32 states that 240 local authorities had joined the Bureau d'Ordre Digital, a platform at courrier.gov.ma for handling incoming and outgoing correspondence electronically, and that GIR-CT was deployed in 969 of 1,590, as of 19 May 2020; it does not state over what connection the offices work.

The annex to circular no. 32 states that 240 local authorities had joined the Bureau d'Ordre Digital for electronic handling of their correspondence as of 19 May 2020; the same annex counts 1,590 local authorities in all.

The annex to circular no. 32 states that 1,030 local authorities had created a dedicated institutional email address for access-to-information requests under law 31.13, following circular no. 269 of 8 May 2020; an address is stated, not a connection at the office.
facts.system: institutional email addresses of local authorities (loi 31.13)

facts.fact: Circular no. 32 of 19 May 2020 is issued by the Minister of the Interior through the DGCT, which sets local authorities' dematerialisation workstreams and had the Bureau d'Ordre Digital developed with the Agence de Développement du Digital; no cost or funding source is stated in the extract.
